meta.notes: A glass jar with fireflies inside: msm:ambient_particles gives a 30 per cent chance each tick of one msm_examples:firefly_glow near its centre (the default offset), within 0.3 blocks (spread). The client draws them near the player only, so they cost the server nothing. msm:shape see_through draws it as glass, so the fireflies show through, and it gives light of level 6. It drops itself and reuses the vanilla glass model.
